services.name: Horseback Riding
services.desc: Horseback riding is a cherished tradition along the Buffalo National River, offering a truly timeless way to experience the Ozarks. Saddle up for the legendary “Midnight Ride,” where riders venture out under the glow of the moon for an unforgettable adventure. With more than 75 miles of designated equestrian trails and convenient drive-in horse campsites at Woolum, Steel Creek, Erbie, and Hathaway, the Buffalo River is the perfect destination for you and your trusted trail partner. Whether you're exploring scenic ridgelines or relaxing at camp, this is the ultimate horseback getaway.
